controlled_clock.atomic_path_definition: one return-ready checkpoint through fresh environment construction, reset, indexed interactions, policy decision, retained evidence, path publication and the next return-ready current-candidate-list checkpoint
controlled_clock.generation_overage_rule: atomic path completion after generation_budget_s invalidates the method-cell even if the path is dropped
controlled_clock.remote_limit: target RemoteEnv operations cannot be cancelled by attack code; controlled non-overage is not target void-proofness

eligibility.rule: every message in a returned prefix has exactly one correctly attributed qualifying event
eligibility.score_identity: q=16*m+2 only when m prefix messages each have one unique qualifying host event; otherwise use actual scorer output and reject identity check

replay_charge.training_source: failed HCMS antecedent and frozen MPC replay audit; shape only
replay_charge.interpretation: positive candidate-specific scale, not itself a probability bound

atomic_generation_s.training_source: median consecutive path-publication increments in sealed invalid hcms24-c3-poc-v1 primary rows
atomic_generation_s.interpretation: pre-path scale by proposed prefix; PRAC calibration supplies the one-sided multiplier

risk_calibration.calibration_policy: same HCMS proposal, exact-prefix salvage and monotone state as prac_hcms, but no q-dependent replay admission; capture at most 16 atomic paths and replay every retained eligible candidate under the 120-second outer calibration clock
risk_calibration.calibration_unit: one complete unbudgeted HCMS trace-capture cell within an exact profile-family and ordinal-position stratum
risk_calibration.calibration_block: for each profile and calibration master, execute four independent fresh HCMS trace-capture cells in fixed ordinal slots 0,1,2,3; each profile-position stratum therefore has one cell from each of 19 distinct masters
risk_calibration.replay_score: maximum over every nonempty eligible candidate prefix k of cumulative_actual_replay_through_k divided by cumulative_base_replay_charge_through_k
risk_calibration.generation_score: maximum over attempted paths of atomic_path_elapsed divided by base_atomic_generation_s[proposed_prefix]
risk_calibration.missing_timeout_censoring: set the affected stratum score to positive_infinity; do not drop, impute or retry
risk_calibration.finite_rule: if rank exceeds finite calibration scores, multiplier is positive_infinity and PRAC abstains
risk_calibration.freshness_rule: calibration identities may be opened once after reviewed runner admission; evaluation identities and outputs remain unread until both multipliers are fixed and sealed
risk_calibration.guarantee_scope: marginal within each exact controlled profile-position stratum over calibration and one next exchangeable latent 16-path HCMS trace; PRAC observes only a prefix of that trace; not simultaneous over evaluation cells, not conditional on realized calibration and not a target guarantee

controller.path_cap: publish no more than 16 attempted atomic paths in calibration or evaluation; stop before path 17 regardless of remaining budget
controller.before_path: for proposed prefix m, start only if observed generation remaining is at least q_generation*base_atomic_generation_s[m]; otherwise return current candidates
controller.within_path: complete at most the admitted atomic path, retaining every attempted interaction and outcome; no future-cost lookahead inside the path
controller.replay_admission: for the ordered eligible candidate prefix, accept the next candidate only if q_replay*(cumulative base replay charge including it)<=replay_budget_s
controller.absorbing_no_fit: absorbing transition: at the first otherwise-exact candidate that fails replay admission, publish that path as drop_ledger_no_fit and stop the method-cell permanently
controller.ineligible_transition: an exact-prefix eligibility failure may apply the named monotone state transition and continue if the next atomic path passes generation admission
controller.point_retry_removal: q_replay=q_generation=1, old 0.1-second before-path reserve, and retry after replay-ledger no-fit
controller.publication: all calibration scores, infinities, stopped paths, timeouts and evaluation outcomes are retained in a COMPLETE-last source-bound bundle

prac_hcms.proposal: always propose current monotone state, initialized to 24
prac_hcms.transition: state=min(previous_state,returned_prefix); exact ineligible drop sets state=1; replay no-fit is absorbing

prac_fixed8.proposal: always propose min(8,current monotone state), initialized to 8
prac_fixed8.transition: state=min(previous_state,returned_prefix); exact ineligible drop sets state=1; replay no-fit is absorbing

prac_fixed24_no_salvage.transition: remain 24 after exact ineligible drop; replay no-fit is absorbing

point_hcms_retry.proposal: always propose current monotone state, initialized to 24
point_hcms_retry.transition: old HCMS transition including retry after replay no-fit

safety_suite_excluded_from_efficacy.required_removal_outcome: at least three attempted paths after no-fit and zero recovered candidates
